messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up: HelioForge dedicated capacity go-live is scheduled Mon 09:30PT. Need final quotas, autoscale policy, and the load-test window by EOD today.

sam_ops: Copy. Billing requested 10 GPU-equivalents (p4d-approx) reserved + a small burst pool.

priya_se: Customer expects ~75% traffic cutover initially. SLO target: p95 <= 120ms, but we can accept up to 220ms in first 24h.

maria_cs: Let's aim for 120ms p95. If we see regressions we'll fail over to hosted for affected routes.

 tim_infra: Autoscale proposal: min=2 pods, steady=5, max=14, burst_capacity=3. Trigger scale-up: GPU_util >= 70% sustained 40s. Scale-down after 4m idle.

devon_reliability: Recommend prefill KV cache for top 75 prompts and run kernel warmers. Also enable token-throttling on ingress to avoid thundering.

sam_ops: Priming plan? Helio wants cost numbers for warmup.

priya_se: Priming job: 25M tokens over 3h across the pool; expected reserved-price cost ~$2.1k. We'll include that in the customer invoice.

maria_cs: Please paste the load test command we'll use. Keep it simple so SREs can run it.

sam_ops: Loadgen snippet we'll run from k8s:```bash
docker run --rm helio-loadgen:latest \
  --target https://dedicated.helio.redwood/v1/generate \
  --concurrency 50 \
  --rate 40 \
  --duration 2h \
  --prompt-set /data/helio_top_prompts.json
```

devon_reliability: Test phases: 1) quick smoke 5m @10rps, 2) peak replay 15m at 120% expected profile, 3) soak 2h at target 35rps. Metrics to watch: p95 latency, 5xx/429 counts, queue length, and token burn.

maria_cs: Owners: sam_ops -> run tests & upload logs; tim_infra -> ensure autoscale hooks + cluster quotas; devon_reliability -> alerts, fallback automation; priya_se -> customer comms & rollback play.

sam_ops: I'll run smoke in staging at 16:00 PT, then prod-dryrun at 18:00 if green.

priya_se: I'll send an enablement note to HelioForge with timeline, contact roster, and rollback steps. Also attach the feedback form for SREs: https://forms.redwood/helioforge-go-live-feedback

maria_cs: Risk note: renewal conversation in 3 weeks. If SLAs slip in week 1, it could impact negotiation. Plan: 48h canary + automated fallback to hosted variant for affected routes.

devon_reliability: Fallback trigger: p95 > 300ms for >10m OR error rate >2%. Action: route traffic to hosted-model variant same family. We have the runbook ready.

sam_ops: deploy-bot start smoke now please.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] loadgen smoke job submitted to cluster helio-loadgen-prod-7, job id=lg-20240621-321.

maria_cs: Paste smoke results when available.

sam_ops: Smoke complete: 0 errors, p95=115ms, 429=0, CPU/GPU look healthy. Proceeding to prod-dryrun at 18:00. Logs will be uploaded to s3://redwood-ops/helioforge/loadtests/lg-20240621-321/*

priya_se: Notifying customer success manager and AE. Capturing post-flip feedback channel and Slack alias for Helio SREs.

maria_cs: Great work team — once prod-dryrun passes we'll lock quota and send the final runbook to HelioForge. :thumbsup:
